“我这是，穿越了？”

平行世界，苏杭。

林修从恍惚之中清醒，看着镜子中更为年轻的自己，一瞬间意识到了这个事实。

他叫林修，穿越前是一名三角洲俱乐部的护航，实力中等偏上。

因好不容易熬夜打完对赌单，最后却被俱乐部找各种理由不给报酬而气血攻心，陷入昏迷。

醒来后，就发现自己穿越了。

这本是一件好事，重返青春的身体也让他有了再拼一回的本钱。

而且根据当前世界给他安排的身份来看，他竟还是一家正规三角洲俱乐部的老板！

具备参与职业联赛的资格。

在这个三角洲行动远比前世还要火热的世界，他完全可以以此谋生乃至做大做强。

然而事实却并非如此，或者说没那么简单。

他的确是一家三角洲俱乐部的老板没错，

但这个俱乐部其实是个空壳，里头没人的啊！

他就只是被世界安排了这样一个身份而已，其他就什么都没了！

“所以说，只有一个空壳俱乐部的我要是还想继续这条路走下去，必须要完全从头开始吗？”

“可是我也没有经营俱乐部的经验啊！”

“而且这个世界的俱乐部都卷成啥样了，给打手待遇一个比一个好。”

“我这一没资金二没渠道的，谁会愿意加入啊？”

林修揉了揉眉心，只感觉事情有点难办。

他现在甚至都想着，要不自己也别开什么俱乐部，要不就直接去干前世的老本行，

去加一个俱乐部当打手得了呗！

前世三十多岁都还有中等偏上实力的他现在年轻到二十岁出头，

考不了魔王，考个顶护还是轻轻松松的。

"Am I traveling through time?"

Parallel world, Suzhou and Hangzhou.

Lin Xiu woke up from his trance, looked at his younger self in the mirror, and realized this fact in an instant.

His name is Lin Xiu. Before time travel, he was an escort for the Delta Club. His strength was above average.

Because he finally stayed up late to finish the betting list, in the end, the club found various reasons to refuse to pay him. He was so angry that he fell into a coma.

After waking up, I found that I had traveled through time.

This was a good thing. Returning to his youthful body also gave him the capital to fight again.

And judging from the status assigned to him in the current world, he is actually the owner of a regular Delta club!

Qualified to participate in professional leagues.

In this world where Delta action is far more intense than in previous lives, he can definitely make a living and even become bigger and stronger through this.

However, this is not the case, or it is not that simple.

He is indeed the owner of a Delta club, yes.

But this club is actually an empty shell with no one inside!

He was just assigned such an identity by the world, and there was nothing else!

"So, if I still want to continue on this path with only an empty club, do I have to start from scratch?"

"But I have no experience in running a club!"

"And the clubs in this world are in such trouble that each one treats its thugs better than the other."

“I don’t have any funds or channels, so who would be willing to join?”

Lin Xiu rubbed his eyebrows, feeling that things were a bit difficult to handle.

He is now even thinking about whether he should not open a club or just go back to his old profession in his previous life.

Just join a club and become a thug!

In his previous life, he was still in his thirties and still had above-average strength. Now he is as young as his early twenties.

If you can't pass the Demon King exam, it's easy to pass the top guard exam.
